title: A mass balance model of the Newfoundland-Labrador Shelf
authors: Alida Bundy; George R. Lilly; Peter A. Shelton
documentation_evidence: 172-page Canadian Technical Report 2310. Detailed Ecopath group input and diet data; precursor to fishing/predation journal analysis.
loadability_evidence: Native EwE loadability has not been tested. Public documentation or data availability alone does not establish a fully working reconstruction.

retrieval_audit.routes_tried: Canada HTML archive notice on first request; normal session cookie and Referer retry returned true PDF from both listed hosts.

loadability_class: C — parameter and diet tables inspected; model import not tested
quality_rationale: Downloaded title verified,172pages. Table2a printed8/PDF22 has initial B/PB/QB/EE; Table2b printed9-10/PDF23-24 initial diet matrix. Table23 printed71/PDF85 has balanced B/PB/QB/EE and harvest. Balancing changes must be followed for reconstruction. Full model import and numerical reconstruction remain untested.
extraction_readiness: Parameter and diet tables located; transcription and balance audit required
geometry_method: No defensible digital study boundary located
recommendation: Shelf system off Labrador and eastern Newfoundland, NAFO 2J3KLNO; broad shelf coverage with fishery-defined domain.
coverage_note: Shelf system off Labrador and eastern Newfoundland, NAFO 2J3KLNO; broad shelf coverage with fishery-defined domain.
